answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 55755 Country: India Title: offering salah behind barelwi Question: (1) My question is that can we offer salah behind Barailavi imam in congregation? (2) I heard that somebody is saying Deoband has given Fatwa that salah behind a Barailavi who used to say 'YAA RASULULLAH' is valid and the muqtadi can get reward. Alhamdulillah, I am Deobandi, if so can I get my individual reward while offering prayer behind Barailavi? Please reply as soon as possible and I will show this answer to my relatives so that I can warn them. Answer ID: 55755 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1417/1413/N=11/1435) (1) If the beliefs of a Bida’ati have not reached to the extent of kufr then salah is valid behind him but it shall be makrooh. Hence you should not offer salah behind him. You should offer salah behind any pious imam in any other mosque. (2) See answer no. 1. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
